spec: specs.md §14.2, §17.2, §15.4; conformance/models/README.md, flaw 1 and its limit
description: A replica written into while Atoll is down, after a crash once its job recorded the change time the copy had right after its rename, by a program that keeps the size and the dates, so that only the change time tells the write: the reprise finds another change time than the one recorded, a write since the rename, and records the part as it was verified, so that the next look reads the edit, a modification propagated to the other copy, the version before going to the trash. Before the remedy of 2026-11-20, the reprise took the change time it found, which it could not tell from the rename's: the edit was recorded as a verified copy of the version it was made from, every later look found it as its row said, and a scrub would have repaired it away.
